records.title: Status of Railway level crossings in Amethi District
details: a to e: There are 38 Nos. of Manned Level Crossings (MLCs) in Amethi District, out of these MLCs, 23 Nos. have been interlocked. Further, 20 Nos. works of ROBs/ RUBs in lieu of MLCs at a cost of Rs. 214 Cr have been sanctioned.

records.title: Drinking water connections under JJM
details: a to b: Thus, as on 03.03.2026, out of around 19.36 Crore rural households in the country, around 15.82 Crore (81.71%) households are reported to have tap water supply in their homes and works for the remaining 3.54 Crore households are at various stages of implementation in respective States.
